news.title: Paxton sues OpenAI, Altman for failing to warn Texans about ChatGPT’s ‘dangers’
news.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton (R) sued OpenAI and its CEO Sam Altman on Friday, accusing the company of failing to warn consumers about the potential dangers from its AI models.
